decisions.reason: As a new bread close to the core bakery range in a growing market, there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration, so boundedly rational management would keep it while learning from another sales cycle.

The guided historic mill tour extends the firm's existing hospitality and experience offer, and without evidence of a clear shortfall the firm would use available organisational slack to continue testing this complementary product.

Because the sweet pastry closely matches the firm's established confectionery capabilities and no negative result is visible after launch, management would judge it acceptable relative to aspiration and retain it.
